package application

import "french-learning-app/internal/domain"

// Virtual file for `go test -overlay` only (FLH-052 converter parity). It is
// never written into internal/application: it lets the runner's tests call the
// actual unexported production converters without exporting them.

func FLH052ProductionQuery(unit domain.KnowledgeUnit) ConceptRetrievalQuery {
	return toConceptRetrievalQuery(unit)
}

func FLH052ProductionDocument(concept domain.KnowledgeConcept) ConceptRetrievalDocument {
	return toConceptRetrievalDocument(concept)
}
